mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (category_id, name, description, type, price, cover_file_id, digital_file_id, status) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{type}, #{price}, #{coverFileId}, #{digitalFileId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, type = #{type}, price = #{price}, cover_file_id = #{coverFileId}, digital_file_id = #{digitalFileId} WHERE id = #{id}
